title: Why are crisis pregnancy centers saying they can 'rule out' ectopic pregnancy?
summary: Under President Trump, more federal attention and support has gone towards anti-abortion Christian centers. A watchdog group says many of them mislead patients with promises to "rule out" ectopic pregnancies.
contentText:
